sections.heading: Planning your Plantation Verge interior
sections.text:
A “plantation” name in Tengah describes the wider new-town cluster, not a confirmed view or landscaping typologies for your block. Owners who are close to keys still need the same first-fit-out discipline as anywhere else in the town: a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall, designed from the approved plan. Maison specifies this as built-in carpentry, not as IKEA-style furniture, and we can work in a wide view or in closer shots of a wardrobe or a kitchen run. No official floor plan is on file, so typologies are not listed, and we will not invent a typical Plantation Verge layout.

Plantation Creek @ Tengah and Garden Waterfront I & II @ Tengah are the other Tengah pages in this batch and should not be used as a date or typologies reference. Keat Hong Grange, already live, and Heart of Yew Tee are nearby Choa Chu Kang links. We will not invent walking times to any present or future MRT station. Check your block, facing and the HDB renovation rules before you plan blinds, a bench or any hacking.

After keys, inspect defects and obtain the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial planning figure only. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and any key letter you have. We are not affiliated with HDB.
